facts.fact: Data Center Dynamics reports that Ethio Telecom, Djibouti Telecom and Sudatel Group signed a strategic agreement under the Horizon Fiber Initiative to build a cross-border terrestrial fibre corridor from Djibouti's submarine cable landing stations via Ethiopia to Sudan's landing stations; the signing was 'last week' relative to the 2026-02-11 article, so the date is approximate.

systems.owner: Ethio Telecom, Djibouti Telecom, Sudatel Group
